supervisor_summary: Research target (12m) $47.66 (update 2026-11-10, was $50.13) vs the 11-10 close $45.24, after the Q3 FY2026 beat and raise: sales 38.1 (+110%), non-GAAP GM 48.7%, EPS -0.05 vs Street -0.16; Q4 guide 43.5-44.5. The set books FY26-29 revenue 141.4 / 188.8 / 218.8 / 242.9, rebuilt from the Q4 carry-in, end-market units, Apollo5 ASP mix and management's non-wearables mix; FY28 revenue is lower than the old carried +28.9% path, so the target falls 4.9%. Base round: Research target (12m) $50.13 (P10 $27.10, P90 $88.90) vs the 11-03 close $44.68, after the citation gate rebuilt every driver year on cited evidence or a labeled trend: FY26 sits on the company's ~$135M sales and ~$85M opex guides, FY27 total revenue on consensus 178.43, and FY28-29 revenue extends the last evidenced growth (+28.9%) because no FY28 guide or free consensus exists (the set's slower +20% path would give $47.85). Valued at 5.02x EV / NTM sales from four comparable peers all on EV / NTM consensus revenue (median 4.785x), plus ~$343M of net cash and interest at the horizon. Concentration (top-3 = 78% of sales) and the Q3 print in November keep this a small, staged position.
